# wordcell

> A knowledge base for coding agents, built from Markdown, backlinks,
> semantic search, and Git context. Wordcell turns sources, plans, and
> decisions into inspectable context that agents can recover across sessions
> without coupling application code to the knowledge system. Markdown and Git
> stay authoritative; every index is derived and rebuildable.

When to use this site:
- Use wordcell.io to learn what Wordcell is, the boundaries it keeps, and the
  current verified install command.
- Use /docs for the complete README: installation, vault format, command
  surface, capture, graph, skills, and release notes.

## Pages

- [Wordcell](https://wordcell.io/): Memory model, interfaces (CLI, TypeScript
  SDK, Agent Skill), trust boundaries, questions, and the verified install.
- [Documentation](https://wordcell.io/docs): The complete Wordcell README
  rendered as a page, including the install reference.

## Source material

- Repository and packaged Agent Skill: https://github.com/hraness/wordcell
- README as Markdown: https://github.com/hraness/wordcell/blob/main/README.md
- Immutable releases: https://github.com/hraness/wordcell/releases
- npm mirror: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@hraness/wordcell
